column1: # Game profile of The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+ (Switch, update 1.7.9b = v524288 + Repentance DLC 010021C000B6B001).
# Custom NVN engine on SDK 13.3.5; modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC) + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.
# main is a launcher that loads Repentance.nro (or AfterbirthPlus.nro) via nn::ro and compiles its 43 GLSL shaders at boot with subsdk0 (captured via porter device_glslc).
# subsdk0 (GLSLC) + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie, imported by AfterbirthPlus.nro and Repentance.nro)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# The NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon.
